fusions.name: Clamp and Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps the target and rolls, winding a conjured mesh around it and dealing 30 damage, always as a critical hit. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drag It Under
fusions.desc: Hauls in a target at or below 30% health from up to 5 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 40% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: The Waiting Jaw
fusions.desc: Sets a jawed snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 60 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 24 damage and is left [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack, Then Teeth
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
